description: NASA Space Technology Taxonomy & Exploration Tech Gaps addressed by TERRA-X analog test recipes.

tech_gaps.title: Precision Landing & Hazard Avoidance in Permanently Shadowed Regions (PSR)
critical_physics: Low-grazing-angle illumination (<3 deg above horizon)
Zero GNSS/GPS availability
High-contrast shadowing and optical blooming
Flash-LIDAR retroreflection on micro-rough regolith
tech_gaps.gravity_compensation_required: Tethered aerial gantry or drone surrogate with scaled descent velocity sqrt(g_moon/g_earth)=0.406

tech_gaps.taxonomy_area: TX06: Human Health, Life Support & Habitation Systems
tech_gaps.title: Regolith Dust Mitigation & Electrostatic Seal Protection
critical_physics: Sub-20 micron jagged, angular, abrasive regolith particles
Triboelectric charging and electrostatic clinging
Vacuum adhesive forces and absence of moisture capillary bridges
Seal degradation and rotating joint abrasion

required_analog_test_conditions.recommended_test_article: Rotary seals, quick-disconnect fluid couplers, solar array hinges

tech_gaps.gravity_compensation_required: Fluidized-bed or vacuum chamber enclosure with electrostatic charge injection

tech_gaps.taxonomy_area: TX07: Exploration Ground Systems & Surface Mechanisms
tech_gaps.title: Cryogenic & High-Delta-T Surface Mechanisms (40K to 400K)
critical_physics: Deep cryogenic cold traps (40K - 70K in lunar PSRs)
Severe diurnal swings (100K night to 390K noon on lunar equator)
Solid lubricant freeze-out (MoS2 degradation below 120K)
Thermal contraction mismatch between composite and metallic joints

required_analog_test_conditions.recommended_test_article: Wheel hub brushless DC actuators, harmonic drives, deployable masts

tech_gaps.gravity_compensation_required: Thermal vacuum chamber (TVAC) interface or cold-plate cryo-shroud

tech_gaps.taxonomy_area: TX03: Power and Energy Storage / Surface Power Grids
tech_gaps.title: Autonomous Autonomous Wet/Dry Cable & Fluid Mating in Contaminated Regolith
critical_physics: Frictional locking of connector guide pins by abrasive dust
High-voltage dielectric breakdown across dust paths in low pressure
Force-torque sensing degradation in non-cohesive terrain
Blind alignment under shadow occlusions

required_analog_test_conditions.recommended_test_article: Autonomously mated power umbilical plugs, blind-mate optical connectors

tech_gaps.gravity_compensation_required: Gravity-offload counterbalance gantry for robotic manipulator (1/6g lunar load bridge)

tech_gaps.taxonomy_area: TX07: In-Situ Resource Utilization & Surface Infrastructure
tech_gaps.title: High-Efficiency Autonomous Regolith Excavation, Conveyance & Site Preparation
critical_physics: Dimensionless cutting force scaling F / (gamma * d^3)
Dilation angle and shearing resistance under low confining stress
Vacuum cohesion increase (clean mineral contacts)
Excavator reaction mass limitation under 1/6g Moon (weight-limited tractive effort)

required_analog_test_conditions.recommended_test_article: Bucket-wheel excavators, vibratory scoops, pneumatic conveyance tubes

tech_gaps.gravity_compensation_required: Dynamic horizontal pull-test rig or 1/6g ballast adjustment (ballast mass = 6x Earth mass to match normal force, or overhead offload cable)

tech_gaps.title: High-Sinkage & Steep-Slope Autonomous Rover Mobility
critical_physics: Slope ratio tan(theta)/tan(phi) exceeding slip-critical threshold
Obstacle clearance scaling h_rms(D)/D > 0.25
Bekker-Wong sinkage z/D under scaled bearing pressure p/(gamma*B)
Grouser soil thrust vs wheel compaction resistance
tech_gaps.gravity_compensation_required: Inclined-plane test track (angle alpha = arcsin(1/6) = 9.6 deg for normal force) or active overhead tension offload
